capabilities: Ask natural-language questions over notes and PDFs with cited answers
Scope questions to the open file, current PDF page, or time ranges
Rewrite selected text with presets shown as a confirmable line-level diff
Build and incrementally update a local vector index of the vault
Ask about pasted screenshots using a vision model
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not an integration with the Lark/Feishu app; it is a fully local alternative to Lark's cloud knowledge-QA product.
extras: Desktop only (isDesktopOnly); scanned PDFs without a text layer are not supported (no OCR); the vector index is stored outside the vault by default and the home page conflicts with Beautitab or Home tab; no telemetry and fully offline by default.
intentEvidence: A local alternative to enterprise knowledge-QA products like Feishu/Lark
motivation: The author wanted Feishu's centered search-box knowledge-QA experience inside Obsidian: "hit a shortcut, a search box appears, type the question" instead of opening a sidebar and picking files.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to ask questions in natural language and get cited answers, and existing AI plugins are sidebar-shaped and often cloud-dependent.
